A 37-year-old female with sharp, intense pain in the lower chest, side of the chest, and breast, radiating to the posterior chest wall. The pain is not related to movement or deep breathing.

Pericarditis: Classic presentation of sharp chest pain.

Myocarditis: Usually has ECG changes.
